introHtml: Recycled buttons, stickers, and patches let you promote your brand without adding virgin plastic or paper to the waste stream. Made from post-consumer or post-industrial materials, these items appeal to environmentally conscious audiences at trade shows, company events, or retail packaging. Choose recycled paper stickers for mailers or recycled felt patches for uniforms. Each piece carries a clear sustainability message that aligns with your company’s green initiatives.
